description: Schema for SKILL.md files per the Agent Skills spec. Used by gen_skills.py to produce valid skill files.

version.description: Agent-determined version based on diff analysis. PATCH: wording/typo. MINOR: new capability, added type. MAJOR: breaking behavior change.

scripts.description: Executable code the agent can run

progressive_disclosure.tier_1: name + description (~100 tokens) — loaded at startup for all skills
progressive_disclosure.tier_2: SKILL.md body (<5000 tokens recommended) — loaded on activation
progressive_disclosure.tier_3: scripts/, references/, assets/ — loaded only when referenced

placeholders.DOC_TYPES_TABLE: Markdown table derived from all doc type schemas (type, naming, sections, statuses)
placeholders.DEFAULT_PATHS: List of default directories per type from discovery.defaults in each schema
placeholders.SUPPORTED_TYPES: Comma-separated type names for the description field
